result.rationale: Ottawa ankle rules negative: able to bear weight for four steps immediately and now, no bony tenderness at malleoli or midfoot, no numbness or wound; soft-tissue tenderness anterior to lateral malleolus consistent with mild ankle sprain. Rest, ice, compression, elevation, and OTC analgesia are appropriate; seek assessment if unable to bear weight, worsening swelling/deformity, or no improvement in several days.
